g.text: Title: Breath Pet - T-Display-S3 USB carrier

g.desc: Title: Breath Pet - T-Display-S3 USB carrier

g.text: Unbuilt prototype - USB only - direct MQ-3 or module assembly variants

g.desc: Unbuilt prototype - USB only - direct MQ-3 or module assembly variants

g.text: ANALOG INPUT: 1/2 SCALE + RC + RAIL CLAMP

g.desc: ANALOG INPUT: 1/2 SCALE + RC + RAIL CLAMP

g.text: Re-baseline and characterize the new sensor before changing game thresholds.

g.desc: Re-baseline and characterize the new sensor before changing game thresholds.

g.text: This circuit measures a relative gas response. It does not measure blood alcohol.

g.desc: This circuit measures a relative gas response. It does not measure blood alcohol.

g.text: BAT54S: pin 1 = A1 (GND), pin 2 = K2 (3V3), pin 3 = junction.

g.desc: BAT54S: pin 1 = A1 (GND), pin 2 = K2 (3V3), pin 3 = junction.

g.text: Protection is supplemental; never bypass the divider or feed AO externally.

g.desc: Protection is supplemental; never bypass the divider or feed AO externally.

g.text: J1 is mechanical only; all 12 pins intentionally isolated.

g.desc: J1 is mechanical only; all 12 pins intentionally isolated.

g.text: Header pin 1 is nearest USB. Top PCB view: USB left, P1 above P2.

g.desc: Header pin 1 is nearest USB. Top PCB view: USB left, P1 above P2.

g.text: Normal firmware already uses GPIO1; no firmware change required.

g.desc: Normal firmware already uses GPIO1; no firmware change required.

g.text: JP1 shunt fitted for normal operation; remove to isolate sensor power.

g.desc: JP1 shunt fitted for normal operation; remove to isolate sensor power.

g.text: J3 is OPTIONAL: fit only when S1 and R4 are not installed.

g.desc: J3 is OPTIONAL: fit only when S1 and R4 are not installed.

g.text: J3 cable order is 5V / GND / AO; leave module DO open.

g.desc: J3 cable order is 5V / GND / AO; leave module DO open.

g.text: S1: verify 9.5 mm pin circle and A/H/B connections on donor.

g.desc: S1: verify 9.5 mm pin circle and A/H/B connections on donor.

g.text: The mirrored A/B groups and heater polarities are interchangeable.

g.desc: The mirrored A/B groups and heater polarities are interchangeable.

g.text: Use either S1 or J3, never both. J3 is unpopulated by default.

g.desc: Use either S1 or J3, never both. J3 is unpopulated by default.

g.text: R4 is unpopulated in the external-module variant.

g.desc: R4 is unpopulated in the external-module variant.

g.text: C1 reservoir: ~0.51 ms nominal RC with R3 + R1||R2.

g.desc: C1 reservoir: ~0.51 ms nominal RC with R3 + R1||R2.

g.text: USB only: the LILYGO 5V pin is not a battery boost supply.

g.desc: USB only: the LILYGO 5V pin is not a battery boost supply.

g.text: Default: R4 = 6.65k; effective load = R4 || (R1 + R2) = 4.73k.

g.desc: Default: R4 = 6.65k; effective load = R4 || (R1 + R2) = 4.73k.

g.text: This is a starting point for a low-resistance MQ-3.

g.desc: This is a starting point for a low-resistance MQ-3.

g.text: Do not assume all cans marked MQ-3 are electrically identical.

g.desc: Do not assume all cans marked MQ-3 are electrically identical.

g.text: See README variant table before buying parts.

g.desc: See README variant table before buying parts.
